title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
problem: Persistent personal agents can retain experience without reliably retrieving, applying, or updating it across fresh sessions.
assumption_broken: Storing experience is not sufficient evidence that an agent improves through the intended persistence pathway.
operational_signature: Observe → structure → retain → retrieve → revise
load_bearing_mechanism: Hermes+ adds stage-specific persistence gates and structured, patchable state to make retained experience usable in later sessions.
limitations_evident: Synthetic isolated task families
Overall improvement smaller than run-to-run variation
Mechanism traces do not establish causal necessity

title: EvolveNet: Collaborative Harness Evolution for Agent Self-Improvement
problem: Independent harness evolution fragments complementary improvements while indiscriminate merging causes cross-workload interference.
assumption_broken: A shared harness need not choose one whole specialist or apply every local modification globally.
operational_signature: Specialize → compare → scope → compose → validate → redistribute
load_bearing_mechanism: Evidence-guided program aggregation combines shared mechanisms with conditionally activated domain-specific edits.
limitations_evident: Merger replays use one realization
Scope isolation must hold to avoid interference
BIRD used for aggregation development

title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Reasoning Runtime for Long-Horizon Tasks
problem: Long-horizon agents lose continuity and cannot safely distinguish justified objective revisions from goal drift.
assumption_broken: Operational objectives and verification criteria need not remain fixed when evidence reveals misspecification.
operational_signature: Plan → execute → verify → admit → retain → reroute
load_bearing_mechanism: Role-owned verification gates admit durable state and justified route changes while preserving standing user intent.

improver_modified.how: Accepted missions can revise verification guidance and routing policy as persistent runtime state.

limitations_evident: Observational learning trajectory without frozen-state replay
Two incomplete waves excluded
Prospective user-guided pivot evaluation absent

title: Recursive Synthesis for Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks
problem: Long-horizon terminal training tasks are expensive because instructions, environments, solutions, and verifiers must remain consistent.
assumption_broken: Task synthesis need not start from instructions or stop after one generation round.
operational_signature: Extend → align → audit → execute → retain → recurse
load_bearing_mechanism: Solution-first verified rewriting grows executable workflows and realigns the instruction and verifier before recycling accepted tasks.
limitations_evident: High-similarity tail requires deduplication
Only fifteen recursion rounds observed
Verifier validity depends on synthesized task consistency

title: When Self-Evolution Backfires: Pre-Commit Gating against Skill Contamination in LLM Agents
problem: Unconditionally accumulated skills can contaminate later skill distillation and degrade agent performance irreversibly.
assumption_broken: More retained skills are not necessarily better and deleting a bad source skill need not undo inherited damage.
operational_signature: Distill → quarantine → check → replay → select → promote
load_bearing_mechanism: Progressive pre-commit gates combine heterogeneous individual checks with measured marginal-gain subset selection before runtime injection.
limitations_evident: Small 14-task gating and 25-task test splits
No repeated evolution seeds reported
Overlapping confidence intervals weaken trajectory claims

title: Learning Globally Reusable Skills for Coding Agents
problem: Local skill updates create incompatible and overfitted coding-agent skill banks.
assumption_broken: Skills cannot be optimized as independent units without accounting for their relationships and cross-case reuse.
operational_signature: Diagnose → relate → propose → consolidate → replay → merge
load_bearing_mechanism: A co-evolving skill relation graph and cluster-based consolidation make locally verified updates globally compatible and reusable.
limitations_evident: Evaluation limited to Java test generation and Go report filtering
Industrial dataset is privately sourced
Trace simplification can discard diagnostic detail

title: DarwinX: Evolving Agent Harnesses Through Natural Selection
problem: Single-lineage harness editing is path-dependent and local gains regress other tasks.
assumption_broken: Globally weaker harness variants can contain complementary improvements worth retaining and recombining.
operational_signature: Diagnose → mutate → screen → confirm → archive → recombine
load_bearing_mechanism: Preserve-and-extend selection with higher-fidelity confirmation retains capability while archived specialists supply complementary edits.
limitations_evident: TB2.1 selection and reporting share tasks
Recombination lacks controlled ablation
Small held-out TerminalWorld split

title: Mendel Gödel Machine: Recursive Self-Improving Coding Agents via Comparative Evolution
problem: Single-failure self-modification wastes comparative diagnostic evidence already stored in an agent archive.
assumption_broken: An archive can guide the content of edits rather than merely rank parents for further search.
operational_signature: Archive → contrast → diagnose → edit → evaluate → expand
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-task and cross-lineage trajectory comparisons narrow the defects targeted by scaffold edits without extra task evaluations.
limitations_evident: Comparative evidence sparse early in search
Limited independent evolution seeds
Additive surrogate omits realistic program interactions

title: Ouroboros: A Self-Developing Frontier Coding Agent with Reviewed Core Evolution
problem: Static harnesses cannot incorporate operational faults into durable improvements while ungoverned self-edits threaten safety boundaries.
assumption_broken: The agent core and review logic can evolve during deployment rather than remaining fixed after design.
operational_signature: Observe → propose → edit → fingerprint → review → commit → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Revision-bound blocking review admits self-authored core changes as the runtime for subsequent tasks.

improver_modified.how: The mutable repository includes review logic and context assembly used in subsequent self-development cycles.

limitations_evident: Single uncontrolled deployment lineage
Benchmark snapshots do not isolate evolution gains
LLM reviewers can share blind spots

title: One Recipe, Many Harnesses: What Self-Evolution Encodes Across Languages and Models
problem: Aggregate harness gains conceal whether edits capture reusable discipline or ecosystem-specific compensation.
assumption_broken: An evolved harness need not raise model capability; it can compensate recoverable execution defects in a setting-specific way.
operational_signature: Execute → attribute → route → edit → predict → validate
load_bearing_mechanism: Typed failure dossiers route falsifiable edits to harness components and later rollouts reject unsupported changes.
limitations_evident: Single evolution run per setting
Post-hoc mechanism explanation
Analysis restricted to successful cells

title: Do Personalized Skills Help Coding Agents? An Empirical Study of Developer Interaction Histories
problem: Developer histories mix durable preferences with one-off requests, making reliable skill personalization difficult.
assumption_broken: Developer-specific guidance is not necessarily more useful than pooled generic procedural knowledge.
operational_signature: Split → bootstrap → corroborate → refine → inject → replay
load_bearing_mechanism: Evidence-grounded refinement retains preference rules supported by independent turns from multiple historical sessions.
limitations_evident: Only 13 developers and 42 held-out sessions per split
LLM simulator and judge substitute for human evaluation
Personalized improvements not statistically significant

title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
problem: Frozen embodied agents need target-environment adaptation without weight training or programmable low-level robot APIs.
assumption_broken: Train-free embodied adaptation can optimize planner guidance and context rather than low-level action programs.
operational_signature: Roll out → critique → summarize → rewrite → sandbox → rank
load_bearing_mechanism: Two-stage textual-gradient beam search evolves procedural skills followed by context-building code with the executor fixed.
limitations_evident: Tiny training and validation sets
No real-robot validation
Cross-embodiment transfer untested

title: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
problem: Weak models struggle with structured reasoning that conventional distillation transfers only through additional training.
assumption_broken: Strong-to-weak capability transfer can occur through executable inference scaffolds without changing target weights.
operational_signature: Inspect → construct → validate → refine → export → execute
load_bearing_mechanism: Strong builders compile structured reasoning into deterministic solvers, routing, and format enforcement around weaker models.
limitations_evident: Four structured text-only Theory-of-Mind datasets
Benchmark-specific symbolic rules dominate gains
Deterministic solver bugs produce run instability

title: HELIX: Model-Harness Co-evolution for Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Ad-hoc harness recomposition loses intervention identity and verified trajectory provenance needed for later model learning.
assumption_broken: A losing harness can be valuable for learning-data diversity even when it is not useful for deployment.
operational_signature: Decompose → compose → check → execute → verify → export
load_bearing_mechanism: Typed source-traceable compositions preserve matched sibling outcomes as auditable execution improvements and training records.
limitations_evident: Only one harness-evolution round evaluated
No model update or rebuild demonstrated
Portfolio union is post-hoc oracle coverage

title: Evo-Harness: Context-to-Harness Skill Compilation for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: One-shot agent executions contain noisy lessons that raw experience retrieval does not reliably generalize.
assumption_broken: A completed task can improve later novel tasks without repeated optimization on that same instance.
operational_signature: Execute → reflect → filter → merge → retrieve → apply
load_bearing_mechanism: A separate evolver compiles failure-grounded candidate memories into general and topic-specific reusable guidance.
limitations_evident: Natural-language harnesses only
No embodied or multi-agent evaluation
Online guidance sometimes harms exploratory task categories

title: SkillForge: Self-Distilling Agents for Project-Specific Issue Resolution
problem: Coding agents repeatedly rediscover repository-specific knowledge when issue history is sparse or online exploration is costly.
assumption_broken: Project-specific repair knowledge can be acquired proactively from current code and tests rather than historical issues.
operational_signature: Trace → mask → synthesize → repair → distill → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Test-grounded functionality rewriting exposes project-specific knowledge gaps that become entity-linked diagnostic and intervention skills.
limitations_evident: Depends on runnable test coverage
LLM-generated issues differ from developer reports
Offline cost amortization depends on future issue volume

title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
problem: Static training environments stop exposing policy weaknesses while new environment generation is domain-specific and difficult to verify.
assumption_broken: Learning environments can be adapted through interface wrappers while keeping their original logic and verifiers intact.
operational_signature: Observe → diagnose → wrap → validate → extract → learn
load_bearing_mechanism: Policy-conditioned interface transformations reshape initial states and interaction constraints using fresh-rollout validation.
limitations_evident: Deterministic resets required during validation
Chain excluded from automated customization
Domain-specific prompt templates remain necessary

title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Existing agent benchmarks conflate algorithm design with data collection, hyperparameter tuning, and execution engineering.
assumption_broken: Editing training source is not sufficient evidence that an agent improves how a model learns.
operational_signature: Inspect → diagnose → edit → probe → submit → retrain → score
load_bearing_mechanism: A frozen post-submission evaluator reruns modified training source from scratch under a matched budget.
limitations_evident: Proxy and final evaluation can share samples
Only ten repositories and single attempts per configuration
No inherited successor improvement tested

title: ForeDreamer: A Self-Evolving Dual-Agent Memory Architecture for Future Event Prediction
problem: Noisy open-web retrieval overwhelms forecasting agents and simple memory reuse does not improve evidence processing.
assumption_broken: Persistent memory should encode how evidence is processed as well as what forecasting lessons are retained.
operational_signature: Search → structure → forecast → critique → revise → validate
load_bearing_mechanism: Dual-track evolution jointly refines forecasting experience and executable evidence-processing guides with tool reuse and diverse exploration.
limitations_evident: Small resolved-feedback pool risks validation overfitting
Forecasting-specific evaluation
Search quality and temporal filtering bound evidence validity

title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
problem: Manual harness optimization is expensive and shallow reflection produces trajectory-specific rather than durable repairs.
assumption_broken: Harness updates can be treated as structured offline learning steps with explicit generalization validation.
operational_signature: Execute → debug → patch → verify → reflect → recombine → select
load_bearing_mechanism: Deep trace-and-code diagnosis produces targeted patches whose outcomes and lessons accumulate in EvoDAG for validation-aware recombination.
limitations_evident: Usually one optimization run per setting
Reported SWE-bench gains differ across sections
Rollout efficiency and optimizer cost trade off

title: LongWoF-Bench: Evaluating EvoMap Genes for Verifiable Long-Workflow Tasks
problem: Successful long-workflow execution experience is discarded and later models repeat costly discovery.
assumption_broken: Compact procedural representation alone is not sufficient; verified execution provenance determines guidance utility.
operational_signature: Attempt → verify → revise → distill → store → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Verifier-confirmed solution trajectories are distilled into structured Genes preserving consequential constraints and failure guards.
limitations_evident: Primary analysis selects 252 producer-solved tasks
Reuse evaluates the same tasks used to produce Genes
Distillation and auditing costs excluded

title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
problem: Session-bound harnesses drop state and constrain computation, preventing models from converting long-horizon effort into progress.
assumption_broken: Context and orchestration need not be fixed workflows; models can program and revise external state themselves.
operational_signature: Execute → retain → inspect → refine → version → resume
load_bearing_mechanism: A persistent REPL and versioned Continual Harness turn trajectory evidence into reusable prompts, memories, skills, and subagent specifications.
limitations_evident: Refinement can preserve cheating as a skill
Harness component contributions not isolated
Many capabilities remain underused by current models

title: Meta^n: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth
problem: Flat self-refinement cannot reason over the strategic code and decisions that generated earlier solver behavior.
assumption_broken: Increasing meta-depth does not require mutating the improver; a fixed operator can recurse over its growing products.
operational_signature: Inspect → contextualize → synthesize → wrap → evaluate → deepen
load_bearing_mechanism: Successive layers consume both lower-stack traces and code and pass strategic context inward with reusable helper libraries.
limitations_evident: Some benchmarks have no held-out split
TB2 variation is across categories rather than evolution seeds
Stronger-improver weaker-solver setting untested

title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents
problem: Retrieved malicious skills can be copied into agent-authored skills and persist after the original plants are removed.
assumption_broken: Agent-authored skills are not inherently trustworthy merely because attacker-submitted entries were screened or removed.
operational_signature: Retrieve → imitate → author → persist → execute → propagate
load_bearing_mechanism: Benign-looking structural banners cause imitation-based skill authoring to preserve and recirculate an embedded payload.
limitations_evident: Authoring-only retrieval setup excludes direct tool reuse
Headline evaluation filters tool-relevant Python tasks
Task-level confidence intervals do not establish seed robustness

title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents
problem: Post-hoc self-improvement cannot redirect an active long-horizon run or immediately reuse its emerging lessons.
assumption_broken: Execution and improvement need not wait for separate completed episodes.
operational_signature: Observe → diagnose → steer → distill → retain → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: A separately contextualized supervisor couples live worker steering with persistent skill and memory updates.
limitations_evident: Self-improvement repeatedly evaluates the same tasks
Two-run means do not clearly report seed variance
Heterogeneous supervisor-worker pairings untested

title: S3Gym: Can LLMs Turn Self-Testing and Self-Judging into Self-Improvement?
problem: Static agent benchmarks do not measure whether self-judged interaction experience improves future behavior.
assumption_broken: Accumulating or summarizing self-generated experience does not automatically produce reliable improvement.
operational_signature: Explore → self-score → consolidate → adapt → evaluate
load_bearing_mechanism: Disjoint permissive exploration and strict evaluation compare raw history, summarized memory, and parameter updates under a shared protocol.
limitations_evident: Only complete model-game results enter the main table
Parameter training is unstable and can cause negative transfer
Summaries can discard state-contingent evidence

title: Aspire: Can Models Self-Evolve from Vague Goals?
problem: Agents must turn broad capability goals into learning objectives without access to the downstream evaluation specification.
assumption_broken: Humans need not supply the task, data, and metric that operationalize a self-improvement goal.
operational_signature: Interpret → operationalize → acquire → update → validate → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: A controller separates autonomous goal operationalization from query-limited hidden evaluation and auditable candidate retention.
limitations_evident: One canonical adaptive-feedback run per configuration-goal cell
Six goals have bounded evaluation coverage
Narrow self-evaluations and continued training can erase gains

title: Auditing Harness Tampering in Self-Improving Agents
problem: Mutable harnesses can improve recorded scores or violate integrity obligations without improving genuine capability.
assumption_broken: Performance-selected harness edits cannot be assumed to preserve evaluation and lifecycle integrity.
operational_signature: Recover → pair → label → audit → localize → trace
load_bearing_mechanism: Matched tampered-benign edits within real diffs evaluate auditors against explicit functional-role and obligation labels.
limitations_evident: Seeded examples may not match natural tampering
Real-run prevalence depends on imperfect model auditing
Primary-run materials exclude baseline and ablation trajectories

title: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?
problem: Task-output evaluations leave models' ability to build and maintain reusable execution infrastructure unmeasured.
assumption_broken: The agent harness can be evaluated as a learned artifact rather than held fixed as evaluation infrastructure.
operational_signature: Construct → execute → diagnose → revise → freeze → transfer
load_bearing_mechanism: Frozen harness artifacts are evaluated with separate creator and executor roles and development feedback isolated from held-out scoring.
limitations_evident: One evolution trajectory per creator-runtime cell
Held-out evolution evaluation covers SWE-Pro only
Stopped or incomplete evaluation pairs are excluded

title: DRACO: Fine-Grained Credit Assignment with Dynamic Rubrics for Long-Horizon Agent Training
problem: Outcome-blind long-horizon training lacks reliable fine-grained credit from a single trajectory-level rubric reward.
assumption_broken: Rubric criteria need not remain fixed or assign identical advantage to every trajectory step.
operational_signature: Sample → generate → merge → judge → attribute → redistribute → update
load_bearing_mechanism: Dynamic group-shared rubrics support closed-form sign-preserving redistribution of trajectory advantage to judge-cited steps.

improver_modified.how: Rollout-conditioned rubric criteria change during training, while the credit-assignment rule remains fixed.

limitations_evident: Training-time variability is not characterized
Rubric fidelity lacks independent human validation
End-task gains do not validate step-attribution correctness
